styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: Marienplatz, the Residenz and the big museums.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: Beer halls, market stalls and hearty Bavarian plates.

styles.label: Nature
styles.blurb: The English Garden, the Isar and day trips to the Alps.

stays.why: Walk to Marienplatz, the Residenz and the Viktualienmarkt. Best for a first visit with little time.
Museum quarter on the doorstep: Alte and Neue Pinakothek, Pinakothek der Moderne. Quiet streets, 10–15 minutes' walk to the centre.
Around the main station: easy airport S-Bahn, cheap hotels, short walk to the Altstadt and Theresienwiese.
Local feel east of the Isar: cafés, the Gasteig area and a short tram or walk to the centre. Good value.

food: Try Bavarian classics: Weisswurst with sweet mustard before noon, roast pork with dumplings, and pretzels.
Beer gardens: sit outside with a Mass (1 litre) of beer and bring your own picnic if you like. Check opening months; many close in winter.
Viktualienmarkt in the Altstadt: stalls for cheese, bread, olives and snacks. Cheaper than restaurant lunches.
Lunch menus (Mittagsmenü) are good value, often EUR 10–16 for a main. Dinner mains run higher.
Book beer halls and popular restaurants on weekends. Tipping: round up or add about 5–10%.
more_time: Day trip to Neuschwanstein or the Alps: trains run from the main station; check times and buy tickets on the day or in advance.
Add a half-day at Nymphenburg Palace and its park; tram reaches it from the centre.
On a hot day, swap a museum for the Isar river banks or a swim at the English Garden's streams.

recommend.why: Two nights covers the Altstadt, the Residenz and the main museums; add a third for a day trip to the Alps or a palace.

month_notes: January: cold, highs around 4°C, some rain. Pack a warm coat and plan indoor sights.
February: still cold, lows near -1°C. Fewer crowds at museums.
March: cool, highs near 10°C. Rain on about 12 days; bring a waterproof layer.
April: milder, highs around 14°C. Beer gardens start to open; evenings still chilly.
May: pleasant, highs near 18°C, but the wettest month with about 16 rain days. Keep an umbrella handy.
June: warm, highs around 23°C. Good for parks and outdoor cafés.
July: warmest month, highs near 24°C. Book hotels early; beer gardens are busy.
August: warm, highs around 24°C. Similar to July; expect some rain days.
September: mild, highs near 19°C. Comfortable for walking and sightseeing.
October: cooler, highs around 15°C. Rain on about 11 days; layers help.
November: cold, highs near 9°C. Christmas market season starts late in the month.
December: cold, highs around 6°C, lows near -1°C. Christmas markets are the highlight; dress warmly.

climate_guide.summary: Temperate continental climate: cold winters, warm summers and rain spread through the year.

items.title: Best time: May to September
items.text: Highs of 18–24°C. Best for parks, beer gardens and day trips.

items.title: Cold winters
items.text: December to February highs of 4–7°C and lows near -3 to -1°C. Snow is possible; pack a warm coat.

items.title: Rain all year
items.text: About 11–16 rain days every month. May is wettest. Carry a small umbrella.

items.title: Mild spring and autumn
items.text: April and October highs of 14–15°C. Good for walking with a jacket.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Layers, a waterproof jacket and comfortable shoes. Add gloves and a hat for winter.

items.title: Seasonal tips
items.text: Beer gardens are best June to September; Christmas markets run in December.

transit.best: U-Bahn and S-Bahn for most trips; the centre is walkable.

modes.text: S-Bahn links the airport and main stations; U-Bahn covers north-south routes. One ticket works across S-Bahn, U-Bahn, tram and bus. Validate before travel or risk a €60 fine.
Buses fill outer gaps. Same ticket as trains and trams.
Trams circle the inner city and reach Nymphenburg Palace.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Bolt operate in Munich.
Fine on the fringes but ring roads are often congested. Use Park & Ride for day trips.
The centre is walkable and bike-friendly, with many cycle paths.
